packed_transform.geometry: 13 records by 21 longwords (42 words) with a one-iteration output pipeline
packed_transform.pipeline_note: Iteration 10 computes the value stored to 0x8000F7CC by iteration 11.

native_trace.interpretation: The integer-mode EMAC smoother halves the low word 0x01EC to 0x00F6 when its source and per-track coefficient are zero.

settling_test.method: Replay the unmodified transform body while retaining live SRAM and captured entry registers.
settling_test.conclusion: Normal settling cannot recover the sample byte while the upstream coefficient inputs remain zero.

upstream_prerequisite.conclusion: Adding event bit 5 cannot initialize the coefficient because the native voice-activation descriptor fields feeding both pointer tables are absent.

ruled_out: A third signed-fractional QEMU helper defect: this loop is executing integer EMAC semantics and the observed half-scale is consistent with its operands.
A packed-source writer race: the parameter bridge intentionally clears 0x80005F36 at 0x4011ACD2.
A simple multi-frame settling delay while the descriptor inputs remain zero.

next_step.name: AR172_QEMU_VOICE_TIMING_DESCRIPTOR_GATE
next_step.objective: Trace the activation paths at 0x4011B940..0x4011BA00 and 0x4011BD70..0x4011BE0A, identify the missing non-proprietary voice descriptor object that should populate 0x8000E4A0/0x8000E46C, and then re-run the native sample consumer.

downstream_input_milestone.name: QWERTY_PAD_TRIGGERING
downstream_input_milestone.plan: Map desktop key-down and key-up events to the validated panel press/release frames after the native sample voice reaches the consumer gate.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: No firmware, extracted MAIN, project data, sample names, descriptor slabs, or proprietary PCM are included. All event-bit and replay interventions were trace-only and remain outside the repository.
